name: Nuclear Threat Initiative
summary: A Washington DC nonprofit founded by Sam Nunn and Ted Turner that works to cut the risks of nuclear war, nuclear terrorism and catastrophic pandemics: Track 2 dialogues and fail-safe reviews with nuclear powers, nuclear materials security, public education, biosecurity policy through NTI | bio (it launched IBBIS, the DNA synthesis screening organisation, in 2024) and a small AI and emerging-technologies programme.
